title: INTF-CLI socket gate-set verb (Gate Registry, bead pg2-h63eu): an external system (or an operator) sets — or renews, or overwrites — the gate of one TYPE. Last writer wins per TYPE; `owner` is the caller's identity, DEBUG ONLY (no behavioral effect, overwritten on re-set); `ttlMs` is an optional lease, renewed by setting the gate again. TYPE is arbitrary but ALL CAPS.
